decisions.reason: The source explicitly asks about the power-board file. It does not change the independently specified sensor-board production package.
Requiring a BOM and manufacturing exports for the power board does not change component availability or sourceability rules.
The requested power-board production files do not change connector labels, marking placement, or other board-identification requirements.
The production-package request does not alter interboard connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or matching-numbering requirements.
The source concerns production-package contents and does not change any battery-protection behavior or threshold.
The requirement to include a BOM and manufacturing exports does not alter the charge-status circuit or its component values.
The production-package request does not change power-board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, or mounting constraints.
The source does not change the board-chain order, power rails, connectors, or forwarding behavior.
A request about the power-board production file does not modify the main-board mechanical layout.
The source does not add, remove, or modify any main-board connector or connector-inventory rule.
The power-board production-package contents do not change the main-board power-source OR-ing design.
The source does not alter standalone USB power behavior, LDO selection, capacity, or debugging support.
